# layers/mobile/flutter/

Flutter app-shell standards — feature-first project structure with four layers per feature and inward dependencies, one shared bootstrap behind every flavor entrypoint, the three error channels, first-frame gating and a startup failure screen with retry, the composition root, ThemeData for light and dark with semantic colours as a ThemeExtension, white-label branding at runtime, platform branching that is overridable in tests, platform code behind an interface with Pigeon channels, the app size budget, and when to split a monorepo. Load when working with entrypoints, bootstrap, theme, app config, dependency wiring, pubspec, or any Dart file with no more specific layer.
